description: This file extends the `CronSettings` class with SwiftUI view components for rendering and interacting with `CronJob` objects, including job rows, context menus, detail headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: An extension adding SwiftUI view functions for `CronSettings`. The class itself is not defined here but extended with these functions.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a view representing a single cron job row with status and name display.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Defines a context menu with actions such as run, open transcript, enable/disable, edit, and delete for a given cron job.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Provides a detailed header view for a cron job with controls like toggle enable, run, transcript, and edit.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Constructs a detailed information card for a cron job, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, next/last run, status, error, and payload.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Displays the run history for a cron job, including refresh and list of run entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Renders a single run log entry with status, date, duration, summary, and error info.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the payload associated with a cron job, varying based on payload type.
